verdict.rationale: Gumloop's agents are chat-based assistants you delegate goals/tasks to — docs show you 'give an agent a goal and a set of tools, and it figures out how to get there' via chat sessions, with generated artifacts, Slack/Teams/email delegation channels, and even a small built-in advisor (Chew) for model selection. This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the delegation experience quality (all evidence is first-party docs).
